remarks: Live Your Best Life in the Heart of New Canaan... Imagine starting your morning with coffee on your private patio, then strolling into town for lunch or catching the train to the city - all without getting in your car. This is the effortless lifestyle waiting for you in this stunning, thoughtfully updated rental. Designed for Modern Living, This exceptional two-bedroom residence has been meticulously updated with today's discerning renter in mind. Each spacious bedroom features its own luxurious en-suite bathroom and generous walk-in closet - no more sharing space or schedules. The convenience of an in-unit laundry room means no more lugging baskets to a common area or planning your life around laundry day. Seamless Indoor-Outdoor - Flow Step through your separate mudroom entrance-perfect for keeping the rest of your home pristine-and enjoy your own private patio, an outdoor sanctuary ideal for morning coffee, evening wine, or weekend entertaining. It's your personal retreat right outside your door. Location, Location, Lifestyle... The true luxury here is location. Walking distance to New Canaan's charming downtown, the train station, and premier shopping means everything you need is just steps away. Skip the car, embrace the walkability, and enjoy the kind of convenient, connected lifestyle that's increasingly rare to find.  This isn't just a rental-it's your new New Canaan lifestyle.
